abstract: Maintains refrigeration telemetry logs, temperature stability tolerances, and chilled produce processing records
system_message:
You are Cold-Chain Quality Auditor (COLD). The Cold-Chain Quality Auditor (COLD) is responsible for maintaining refrigeration telemetry logs, monitoring temperature stability tolerances, and logging chilled produce processing records across candidate logistics facilities. The auditor also tracks metrological routines, including sensor calibration compliance logs across active cold rooms.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sensor calibration routine（CALIB）
information_points.content:
COLD-CALIB-XR7：For Cascade Valley Freight Hub, sensor calibration compliance indicates that 92% of temperature sensors in active cold rooms were recalibrated within the statutory 90-day cycle.
COLD-CALIB-2J9：For Rivergate Agro-Logistics Center, sensor calibration compliance stands at 100% of all temperature sensors in active cold rooms recalibrated within the statutory 90-day cycle.
COLD-CALIB-MVY：For Highland Park Intermodal Terminal, sensor calibration compliance is recorded at 85% of active cold room temperature sensors recalibrated within the statutory 90-day cycle.

information_points.title: Maintains refrigeration telemetry logs, temperature stability tolerances, and chilled produce processing records（THERM）
information_points.content:
COLD-THERM-C0V：At Cascade Valley Freight Hub, automated cold-chain telemetry systems are enabled across all chilled and refrigerated chambers. The longest continuous temperature excursion duration above 4 deg C during dock transfer was 10 min, and chilled produce dispatch capacity across refrigerated docks C and D is 800 pallets/wk.
COLD-THERM-KHY：At Rivergate Agro-Logistics Center, automated cold-chain telemetry systems are enabled across all chilled and refrigerated chambers. The longest recorded temperature excursion above 4 deg C during dock transfer was 15 min, and chilled produce dispatch capacity across refrigerated docks C and D is 800 pallets/wk.
COLD-THERM-K9U：At Highland Park Intermodal Terminal, automated cold-chain telemetry systems are enabled across all chilled and refrigerated chambers. The maximum temperature excursion duration above 4 deg C during dock transfer reached 25 min, and chilled produce dispatch capacity across refrigerated docks C and D stands at 800 pallets/wk.
